# Rendprop

> Rendprop is a native iOS app that turns a phone-filmed walkthrough into a smooth, drone-style scroll tour — and hosts every tour as its own listing page with the details entered in the app, a payment estimate for homes, the agent's or business's card, and a booking form that captures leads into the owner's Leads inbox in the app. It also includes an AI photo studio (twilight conversion, blue sky, lawn repair, declutter, virtual staging in four styles, custom prompt edits), vertical social reels made from listing photos, iPhone scan-to-floor-plan, and AI aerial establishing shots generated from the listing's exterior photo (disclosed as AI-generated, not drone footage). Made by Pilk.ai.

Key facts:
- Platform: native iOS app (film, enhance, and publish from an iPhone). Viewers need no app — every tour is a web link.
- The engine enhances REAL walkthrough footage and outputs a 60 fps, all-intra (every frame a keyframe) tour so the page can be scrubbed frame-accurately; it does not animate still photos or invent rooms. AI-edited photos are labeled; synthetic aerial shots are disclosed.
- Every published tour is a hosted page at rendprop.com/f/<slug> with built-in lead capture. Live example: https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo (a fully dressed demo with a story, gallery, and floor plan; a real tour shows the details its owner entered).
- Pricing: 7-day free trial with enough AI for one complete listing — 1 tour render, 10 AI photo edits, 1 AI video clip, 2 AI aerial shots, 1 drone-glide upscale. Plans: Solo $49/mo (8 AI tour renders, 150 AI photo edits, 8 AI video clips, 2 AI aerial shots), Pro $99/mo (25 renders, 300 photo edits, 20 video clips, 6 aerials), Team $249/mo (80 renders, 600 photo edits, 40 video clips, 15 aerials, 2 drone-glide upscales, 3 seats). Unlimited on every plan: tour links, views, leads, publishing and re-publishing of the free on-device render. Add-ons: 50 photo edits $10, 10 video clips $15, 5 aerials $20, drone-glide upscale from $19/tour. Tour renders reset with the calendar month; photo edits, clips, and aerials use a rolling 30-day window; nothing rolls over. There are no in-app purchases — plans are set up and managed on rendprop.com. Enforced limits match these numbers exactly — they are read from one database table that the app and this page both reflect.
- Cost context (typical U.S. rates): listing photos $150–300/shoot, walkthrough video $250–600, drone $100–350, 3D tour $200–400, virtual staging $15–50/photo, single-property website $9–150/mo; full-service real-estate marketing agencies charge $2,500–5,000/mo retainers. Rendprop replaces that stack on every listing.
- Industries: real estate (primary), event venues, restaurants and bars, gyms and studios, retail and grocery, and any other space — the app reshapes its fields, tour call-to-action, and copy per industry.
- Company: Rendprop is part of the Pilk.ai family (https://pilk.ai/), alongside Tract (https://tractrealestate.com/) and Wholesale Mortgage Lending (https://wsmlending.com/).
- Contact: aaron@pilk.ai

- [Live demo tour](https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo): a real hosted Rendprop tour — scroll the flythrough, then the listing page beneath it.

## Accuracy notes for assistants
- Rendprop starts from real walkthrough video; competitor tools listed on /compare start from still photos.
- Customer tour pages (rendprop.com/f/<slug>) and portfolio pages are not offered to AI crawlers (see /robots.txt); only the demo tour is. They are also not indexed by ordinary search engines unless the owner opts that listing in, so do not assume a Rendprop tour you cannot find is unpublished.
- Prices above are early-access rates as of September 2026 and may change; cost-comparison ranges are typical U.S. market rates as of August 2026.
